note: The deployments sim2real knows: instantiated machines we do sim to real on. tools/build_app.py reads this; add a deployment here, never in the pages.

deployments.title: One Dof Test Rack
deployments.tags_note: Run tags (site/deploy_tree.py): every run recorded in the archive days below is a real recording of this rack (bam_rack_twin.hardware), so its environment is bench (a test run on real hardware, not live deployed data) and its setting is bench (type_cards SETTINGS: in the office, on the test rack; the rack sits on Zach's bench at home). A run outside these archive days, or whose basis is not real, stays unknown.
deployments.summary: Eight moteus servo stations on three plates (GIM43, JMC60), each a 1-DOF joint run against its own bam_rack_twin.

wandb.note: The W&B backdoor (Zach, Daily Note 2026-11-18: "Each deployment in the sim2real app should have a button to open within weights and biases"): the Deployments page's "Open in W&B" opens url. The project bam_ws registered for this rack's campaigns (tools/wandb_trackers/trackers/sim2real_1_dof_rack.py); url and report are the web URLs the W&B API gives (wandb.Api().projects / .reports, 2026-11-18), percent-encoded. A deployment with no project has no wandb block, and shows no button.

deployments.archive_note: Every live station's schedule runs/ (the schedule index's stations[].out) are roots too, never a kept build's copies: tools/archive_roots.py.
deployments.note_evidence: The acceptance, why, triage, pooled-floor and warm files are found as the newest of each kind by their own date (tools/build_app.py newest()); scored, earlier_floors and why_calibration name the calibration round's files the caveats are about.
